paragraphs: The dispute centers on whether Puerto Rico's sovereign immunity blocks federal court suits against its financial oversight board. The board claims Congress waived this protection. Puerto Rico argues its status as a territory preserves immunity.

paragraphs: This case defines the legal shield protecting Puerto Rico's government from federal litigation. It determines whether the territory can be sued in federal court for board actions. The outcome shapes the balance of power between federal oversight and local governance.
